title: AuditIQ: every measured result, machine-readable

full_report.about: methodology, every result in detail, per-invoice analysis, threats to validity

labels.measured: a script of the repository produced it on the data stated
labels.pilot: measured on 20 invoices of the development ledger; shows that the stages work
labels.sample: measured on a sample of a benchmark ledger (34 invoices of ledger 101; 90 of ledger 202); too small to estimate the benchmark
labels.expected: targets fixed before measurement; not results (RESULTS.md, Section 10)

data: Synthetic ledgers of AuditIQ-Bench (auditiq/data/): three benchmark ledgers of 5,000 invoices (8.4% anomalous), a policy-swap ledger, a development ledger and a large ledger of 20,000 invoices.

controls_against_classical_detectors.label: measured
controls_against_classical_detectors.question: How do the deterministic controls (C1) compare with an isolation forest and a one-class SVM (C0, thresholds cross-fitted on other folds) at finding anomalous invoices?
controls_against_classical_detectors.note: 95% bootstrap intervals over invoices, 1,000 resamples. The controls' perfect scores on the rule-defined classes R1-R10 are by construction: they implement the rules by which these anomalies were injected. J1-J4 are left to the language-model agents.

policy_change.label: measured
policy_change.question: When the organisation changes its policy and supplies only the new PDF, does the system decide every invoice as the new policy requires, and how wrong is a system whose thresholds are frozen at version 2.5?

variants.change: invoices per vendor per day 3 to 2
invoices per vendor per day 3 to 5
tolerance 0.5%, daily count 2, Manager 50,000, Senior Manager 250,000, round multiple 5,000
tolerance 5%, daily count 5, Manager 150,000, six-day week, round multiple 50,000
tolerance 5%, daily count 5, Manager 150,000 (the policy-swap version)

held_out_policy_documents.label: measured
held_out_policy_documents.question: Does the reader work on policy values that played no part in building or checking it? Twenty documents drawn at random (seed 2026), each changing one to five values.

variants.change: guide_window_days 14; CFO limit 20,000,000; non_business_days ['Sunday']; amount_tolerance_pct 4.0; max_invoices_per_vendor_per_day 6
CFO limit 20,000,000; round_amount_multiple 25000; Manager limit 125,000; guide_window_days 10; guide_band_pct 20

robustness_of_the_reader.label: measured
robustness_of_the_reader.question: Does the reader either read an edited policy document correctly or refuse it?

edits.edit: extra prose and a revision table before the rules
rules and sections in another order
every rule followed by a long explanation
45 notes before section 4, which push the later rules onto later pages
the approval table in another order
the severity of rule 2.1.1 changed from high to low
approval limits in Indian digit grouping
the threshold sentence of rule 2.1.1 removed
a rule added that the system has no control for
a non-business 'day' that is not a day of the week
rule 2.1.1 stated twice, with 1% and with 2%
the approval table without the CFO

robustness_of_the_reader.note: The first run found two ambiguous documents adopted (a rule stated twice; an approval table without a role). Both checks were added to the reader with tests; both runs are kept.

policy_change_in_the_application.label: measured
policy_change_in_the_application.question: A policy change through the deployed path: the 20,000-invoice ledger in a database, audited, the strict policy PDF adopted, audited again.

every_ledger_through_the_deployed_system.label: measured
every_ledger_through_the_deployed_system.question: What does the deployed system produce when each ledger of the project is loaded from an Excel workbook and audited with the controls through the data store?

scalability_of_the_control_stage.label: measured
scalability_of_the_control_stage.question: How fast is the control stage, against worker processes and ledger size?
scalability_of_the_control_stage.machine: Intel64 Family 6 Model 154 Stepping 4, GenuineIntel, Python 3.11.3
scalability_of_the_control_stage.note: The control stage in memory on one laptop, median of three runs. A rerun under background load gave the same findings with 21-36% lower throughput (RESULTS.md, Section 5).

policies_in_their_own_wording.label: measured
policies_in_their_own_wording.question: Policies written in their own wording: a local 7B model proposes the values, code verifies each against the document, a person confirms. Six documents, 14 values each.

policy_search.label: measured
policy_search.question: Policy search: recall of the right passage for 48 fixed questions (16 in the policy's wording, 32 paraphrases split into dev and test).

vendor_history_cap.label: measured
vendor_history_cap.question: Does the cap of 40 vendor-history invoices per rule hide an invoice that a labelled case depends on?

revisions_of_control_findings.label: measured
revisions_of_control_findings.question: For every finding of the controls, is the computed revision right: does an invoice amended or re-approved as it says pass the rule it failed, with no new finding? (The revision stage of AuditBench, for the rules the controls decide.)

llm_stages_pilot_20_invoices.label: pilot
llm_stages_pilot_20_invoices.question: The five configurations with a local 7B model on 20 invoices of the development ledger.
llm_stages_pilot_20_invoices.note: Too few invoices to compare configurations: no difference between them is significant.

llm_stages_sample_34_invoices.label: sample
llm_stages_sample_34_invoices.question: The five configurations with a local 7B model and frozen prompts on 34 invoices of benchmark ledger 101.
llm_stages_sample_34_invoices.note: Too few invoices to compare configurations: no difference between them is significant.

llm_stages_sample_90_invoices.label: sample
llm_stages_sample_90_invoices.question: The five configurations with a local 7B model on the laptop's integrated GPU and frozen prompts on 90 invoices of benchmark ledger 202 (15 of each judgement class, 4 of each hard-negative type, 10 ordinary).
llm_stages_sample_90_invoices.note: A stratified sample of the evaluation subset, not the full run; read differences between configurations from the McNemar tests of the source.

huge_ledger.label: measured
huge_ledger.question: Do the results hold on a ledger of 500,000 invoices, and does the deployed path carry it?
